papers.title: TaQFormer: A Treatment-as-Query Transformer with Data-Fusion for Multidimensional Treatment Modeling in Coupon Allocation
papers.key_evidence: Authors report a 14-day online A/B test with 1.26% higher focal-category business value per user at essentially equal subsidy cost rate. The absolute business metric is undisclosed.
papers.canonical_note: 论文精读/TaQFormer/TaQFormer：多维优惠券建模与OBS-RCT融合.md

papers.title: LCM-Promo: An LLM-Based Uplift Model for Promotion Allocation
papers.status: arXiv manuscript; paper links to an ECML PKDD 2026 version of record
papers.key_evidence: Authors report relative conversion +1% and promotion cost -6% versus Segment-EMA in a one-month iFood churn-reactivation A/B test with the same allocator and global budget constraint. Offline AUUC/Qini are comparable to uplift random forest, with lower Uplift@30.

papers.title: Interpretable and Validatable Uplift Modeling
papers.key_evidence: Data splitting, tree summaries and hierarchical effect/heterogeneity testing with FWER guarantees under valid tests; theoretical and simulation evidence, not an online business-lift result.

papers.title: Jointly Optimizing Debiased CTR and Uplift for Coupons Marketing: A Unified Causal Framework
papers.status: CIKM 2026 manuscript; recent revision of an earlier paper
papers.key_evidence: UniMVT jointly models baseline CTR and intervention response using disentangled representations and logit-space counterfactual consistency. Latest manuscript reports coupon revenue +18.14% against its two-stage production baseline; no cross-paper comparison is justified. Model assumes monotonic linear treatment shifts in logit space.

papers.title: UpliftBench: Revealing Outcome-Regime and Objective Mismatch in Uplift Evaluation
papers.status: arXiv preprint; supplementary item just outside the 90-day window
papers.key_evidence: 12 estimators, seven dataset families. IHDP Qini-effect accuracy mean rank correlation +0.07, 95% CI [-0.03,+0.16]; result is not universal and was not detected on ACIC or Revenue-Synthetic. Jobs threshold-policy mismatch disappears under a rank-sufficient budgeted-value objective.
